==Overview==
===Format===
*'''Group Stage''' - ''June 13th - August 4th, 2019''
** Double Round-Robin
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}
** 1st place gets seeded to the Finals
** 2nd place gets seeded to the Semifinals
*** 3rd and 4th qualify to the first round of Playoffs

*'''Playoffs''' - ''August 23rd - August 31st, 2019''
** Single Elimination King of the Hill.
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}
** Winner qualifies for [[World Championship/2019|World Championship 2019]].
